items.headline: Albemarle Stock And 2 U.S. Metals Plays Shaped By New Canada Tariffs
items.snippet: Albemarle gives investors direct exposure to lithium and energy storage materials that are central to U.S. electrification and battery demand. Recent U.S. Canada tariffs on metals add another layer of interest for a company already involved in critical materials pricing.
